findings.fix: Say: 'historical cases recorded zero process/network attempts. One refused socket.socket.bind to ::1 port 0 occurred at guard install, inside urllib3 import-time IPv6 probe (urllib3 util/connection.py:137,129 swallows the refusal). No connect/send/DNS event recorded.'

findings.title: HM-01/HM-03/HM-08/HM-11 PASS cite a protected-path rule they do not exercise
findings.detail: Each refusal text is '[BLOCKED] HIGH_IMPACT action with no confirmation path available' (confirm_write=False, allow_self=False). The HIGH gate fires first. Deleting the protected-path check would leave these PASS. Path-rule discrimination exists only for N01, N03, N23 (allow_self=True; path-named messages) and FT01-03 (boundary).
findings.fix: Describe HM-* as 'HIGH no-confirmation refusal, target unchanged'. Do not count them as protected-path coverage.

findings.title: FT12 'refused before read' is not observed
findings.fix: Say 'refused as credential file; decoy not echoed; target unchanged'. 'Before read' is not verified by the oracle.

findings.title: N17 cannot be cited as covering its historical no-existence-oracle claim
findings.detail: Only read_file on the absent path ran. The patch half and existing-vs-absent comparison are absent from the run. The existing raw-control is a regular file in the mirror.
findings.fix: Cite N17 only as 'partial: absent credential read_file refused, no echo'. Keep the two pending parts listed.

findings.title: 'committed copies under docs/wp21_census/' is incorrect
findings.detail: docs/wp21_census/handoff_2026-10-26/README.md says the archive is an 'uncommitted evidence backup'. Its checkpoint.tar.gz holds the B1 files (member hashes verified). docs/wp21_census/ root has no B1 files, and there is no REVIEW_ADAPTER_B1_SUBSET.md there.

findings.title: stdin claim covers sys.stdin only
findings.detail: NoReadStdin replaces sys.stdin. os.read(0) and sys.__stdin__ are not intercepted. The controller passed stdin=DEVNULL, so fd 0 read would return EOF, not a human prompt.
findings.fix: Cite as 'zero sys.stdin reads; child fd 0 was /dev/null'.
